sloka: न च इयम् तव काकुत्स्थ व्रीडा भवितुम् अर्हति ।त्वया त्रैलोक्य नाथेन यत् अहम् विमुखी कृतः ॥१-७६-१९॥
transliteration: na ca iyam tava kākutstha vrīḍā bhavitum arhati ।tvayā trailokya nāthena yat aham vimukhī kṛtaḥ ॥1-76-19॥

translations.english: I have been defeated by you, O Descendant of Kakustha lord of the three worlds. Therefore, it is not right for me to feel ashamed.
